listing.name: World Driver Championship — worlddriverchampionship-recomp (alondero)
listing.summary: Upstream Windows x64/Direct3D12 tests cover intro, menus and Hawaii practice driving: acceleration, steering, automatic gears and pause/resume. This remains an early development build with rendering glitches and experimental SDL audio. The frontend-enabled player now advertises rumble alongside persistent Controller Pak saves on port 1, with strength in General settings; physical controller compatibility and feel remain unverified. Linux/Android are unvalidated. No Portcove build, save, controller, audio or gameplay qualification. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA ROM. This guide does not include the exact supported revision or hash; check the project’s game-specific profile before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run the source build.ps1 with your own USA ROM, then start play.ps1. The reviewed README does not establish a published player package.
